summary: UBS Group AG filed Form 6-K providing its consolidated capitalization table as of March 31, 2026, along with routine quarterly financial disclosures and incorporation by reference into existing registration statements. The filing does not announce or relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. It is a standard foreign private issuer report for the first quarter of 2026, with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
